# Access policy — fictional Northstar Labs
Employees request production access through the Access Portal. A manager and the service owner must approve each request. Access expires after 30 days unless renewed.

Contractors receive read-only staging access. Contractors cannot receive production access under this policy. All accounts must use multifactor authentication.

# Data retention policy — fictional Northstar Labs
Application logs are retained for 30 days. Financial audit records are retained for seven years. Customer deletion requests are completed within 21 days after identity verification.

Production backups are encrypted and retained for 90 days. The security team reviews data access permissions quarterly. Sensitive personal information must not appear in application logs.

# Deployment guide — fictional Northstar Labs
Production deployments require a passing test suite and one reviewer approval. The release engineer deploys to staging before production.

Roll back if the error rate exceeds two percent for five consecutive minutes. Database migrations must be backward compatible. Deployments are paused during an active severity one incident.
